messages:
sam_csm: hi all — sam here (new CSM). trying to get set up for customer onboarding. I can't access Gainsight (license error) and Zendesk role seems read-only. also need the CSM playbook + the post-onboard checklist. who do I ping? :wave:
maya_enablement: welcome sam!! i handle CSM enablement. quick checklist: 1) confirm corporate email 2) which accounts you'll own first week 3) do you need admin in Zendesk or agent with macros? share email and i'll start provisioning + share playbook links.
alex_it: tagging in. please confirm your email and whether you've accepted Okta invite. if you see "no license assigned" in Gainsight that's an entitlement issue. i'll file a ticket if needed.
sam_csm: email is sam@redwood.ai. accepted Okta. Gainsight shows: "You are not licensed to use this application". Zendesk role: 'Light Agent' — can't add internal notes or update custom fields.
rob_salesops: for handoffs we use the property mapping: HubSpot -> Zendesk -> Gainsight. i'll confirm property names once you're in. also i'll add you to the "CS-onboard-rotation" calendar so you can shadow first 3 onboarding calls.
onboarding-bot: new-hire checklist created for sam_csm. Next steps: IT to assign Gainsight license, Enablement to share CSM playbook, SalesOps to add to shadow rota.
gainsight-bot: entitlement-check: sam@redwood.ai -> license: NONE. recommended action: assign seat from pool CS_POOL_02 or request purchase.
alex_it: filed IT ticket IT-5690: "Assign Gainsight license & upgrade Zendesk role for sam@redwood.ai". ETA 4 hours. logs: okta_provision: 1750201100, last_sync_error: entitlement.
maya_enablement: in the meantime here's the internal CSM playbook and checklist: https://docs.redwood.ai/cs/csm-playbook and the quick 15min walkthrough: https://videos.redwood.ai/onboarding/csm-1. also here's the playbook TL;DR: 1) first 3 calls shadow, 2) pre-kick email template, 3) 30/60/90 plan.
sam_csm: got the links, thank you. is there a CSV of active customers I should import or will that be handled centrally? the account list in Gainsight is empty for me.
rob_salesops: we'll push the account roster. i'll create a Zapier sync to surface HubSpot opportunities into Gainsight health for the first week; watch for reminders in the shared sheet.
alex_it: update on IT-5690: assigned Gainsight license from CS_POOL_02 and changed Zendesk role to 'Agent' at 1750201380. please re-login and verify.
sam_csm: re-logged in — Gainsight now shows my account & seat. Zendesk permissions let me add internal notes. spotted a couple of customers missing onboarding templates though.
maya_enablement: i'll drop the onboarding templates into the customer drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/cs/onboarding-templates. use the "Enterprise Kickoff" template for customers >$25k ARR.
rob_salesops: FYI mapping we use: hubspot.properties.owner_email -> zendesk.custom_agent -> gainsight.account_owner. if you see a mismatch open a ticket titled "CS Mapping" and tag me.
onboarding-bot: reminder: sam_csm added to "CS shadow rota" for Wed 10:00am.
sam_csm: all set — can confirm I can access playbook, customers list, and Zendesk macros. two quick Qs: 1) where's the escalation matrix? 2) how do I request a custom segment in Gainsight?
maya_enablement: escalation matrix is in the playbook appendix (section 5). for custom Gainsight segments ping @rob_salesops with segment criteria and i'll review.
rob_salesops: will handle segment requests. also assigned @sam_csm to the onboarding call tomorrow (calendar invite sent).
sam_csm: thanks everyone. huge help — first-day wins. i'll shadow tomorrow and follow up if any syncs break. :tada:
